summary: A badge inside a wider pill with a short message, such as news above a heading.

props.name: children
props.example: Folders now sync across your devices

props.name: href
props.description: Where the announcement goes. Without it, the pill is plain text.

props.name: solid
props.description: A solid badge in place of the tinted one, for news that leads a page.

props.name: dot
props.description: A dot in the badge, before its word.

props.name: badgePosition
props.description: Which end the badge sits at.

props.name: arrow
props.description: An arrow at the end, saying the pill is a link. Shown with `href`.

props.name: intent
props.description: What the news means, which tints the badge.

props.name: size
props.description: Padding and text size, the badge's with it.

props.name: shape
props.description: Corner radius of the pill and its badge. Inherits the nearest `Shape`; under the default, a pill.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes. `merge` folds them in last, so one here replaces the component's own class for the same utility.

props.name: focus
props.description: The focus outline. `true` draws it, `false` removes it, and a string of Yumma CSS utilities restyles it. Removing it outright and putting nothing back fails WCAG 2.4.7.

scene.children: Folders now sync across your devices
